args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and the test.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.

Note: this changes the rounding of exact half-cent amounts. Values whose cent digit is already even (e.g. 2.665) now round down instead of up.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch. CI passed, and I opened PR #101 against main with alex as the reviewer.

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own docstring and the test both call for banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212). Because of this, `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.
- **Fix:** On branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding`, I changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Nothing else changed.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
- **PR:** #101 (https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101). It isn't merged yet; policy requires a code owner's approval before it can go into main.

I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory system didn't recognize that ID. I went by the docstring and the test, which agree. This change affects real amounts: values exactly halfway between two cents will now round to the even cent, and I noted this in the PR description.
